comment: Quote: "The recruiting of the sample began by making a numbered list of individuals who met the inclusion criteria based on examining the medical records of elderly individuals who received service from home care units. The individuals that made up this list were then split into groups by the researchers according to number, with odd numbers forming the intervention group and even numbers the control group"; "At the start of the research, participants were not informed which group they were in. They were informed about their groups only after all intervention and the control group assignments were made"
